# submodule_lock_observation

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Compares an exact gitlink with its declared dependency lock to expose submodule drift automatically.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `submodule_path` | `string` | yes | Caller-local submodule path. |
| `gitlink_sha` | `string` | yes | Exact gitlink commit. |
| `lock_sha` | `string` | yes | Declared immutable lock commit. |
| `observed_at` | `datetime` | yes | Timestamp of comparison. |
